rationale: The verified synthetic_worlds instrument is now available on main at src/sim/synthetic_worlds/ with terminal state SNS_SYNTHETIC_WORLD_CORE_IMPORTED. At the next monthly governance transaction, explicitly choose one disposition: activate QST-SYNTH-0001 when a lawful queue slot exists; attach a smaller bounded synthetic-world experiment to a suitable active quest such as QST-STOR-0002 after its owning acceptance slice permits it; or defer with a reactivation condition. Consult docs/system/research_instrument_registry.md. This proposal does not activate a quest, change priority, begin generation, or treat synthetic output as physical-world evidence.
